text:
rachel: Heads-up for tonight's micro-canary for feature.flag_micro_opt. Window 01:00-02:00 UTC. Plan: 0.1% (10m) -> 1% (15m) -> 8% (20m) -> 100% manual with oncall check at 8%.
sam: please pin 'e2e-team' cohort to v2 for the full run so we get test signals.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled 2026-01-12T01:00:00Z. Will execute shifts and post telemetry snapshots. Will pause for manual holds.
infra-nik: reserve note: set region eu-north reserve=4% to avoid autoscaler thrash during 1%->8%.
oncall-jess: i'll be oncall. If deploy-bot pauses and I don't ack in 3m, auto-disable per policy. Ping @jess.
rachel: rollback triggers: 1) 5xx > 0.7% sustained 3m, 2) semantic regression alert (nonsense +9%), 3) GPU OOMs. On trigger: disable flag, pin back to stable route, open incident.
sam: ops quick commands: ```
# disable flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF" https://flags.redwood/api/v1/flags/feature.flag_micro_opt/disable
# pin to stable
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" https://ops.redwood/api/v1/pins -d '{"service":"route-lm","version":"v1.3"}'
```
deploy-bot: preflight passed in staging at 00:20 UTC. Ready to run. Will tag events rollout_id=20260112_microcanary.
rachel: release note short: "Incremental enable of micro-optimizer to reduce token latency for short prompts; gradual rollout, monitoring enabled."
